description: Test file for the nfacct package, including mock implementations and tests for adding, getting, ensuring, listing, and decoding network flow counters via netlink on Linux systems.

classes.name: fakeHandler
classes.description: Mock implementation of handler interface for testing netlink requests and responses.

classes.name: fakeRequest
classes.description: Mock request object capturing command, flags, data, response, and error for testing.

methods.name: newRequest
methods.description: Creates a new fake request with specified command and flags, and predefined response/error.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Returns nil, as serialization is not implemented in the mock.

methods.name: AddData
methods.description: Adds netlink request data to the fake request.

methods.name: AddRawData
methods.description: No-op in mock, as raw data addition is not simulated.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Returns predefined response and error for the fake request.
